Steps.Step: Record the absence evidence FIRST, before any edit, in the bundle evidence: grep tests/renderer for component-level docx lifecycle assertions and capture the output — expected: editor-export-images.test.js carries only the consent-gate wiring pin (:622-643, ending at the embed pass assertion :642), editor-print-clearup.test.js and editor-coverage.test.js carry no docx leg at all, and the conversion-failure notice is owned by store isolation (export-docx-dispatch.test.js:123-129). Pin one (named failing-first, lands green — coverage-first): Async discipline for all three pins: the docx dispatch is fire-and-forget (editor.vue:2629 calls editorStore.EXPORT without await, unlike the pdf branch :2686), so after awaiting the bus handler the store tail (dialog → conversion → write → notice) is still in flight — assertions ride vi.waitFor / the suite's deferred-release pattern, never a bare await-then-assert. «docx: a successful export writes the rendered document through the store and never engages the print container» — resolve the save dialog to '/tmp/test.docx' (save.mockResolvedValueOnce), stub the double to resolve bytes, spy the real store action with vi.spyOn(editorStore, 'EXPORT') (call-through preserved), drive getBusHandler('export') with type: 'docx' and await it; assert exactly one dispatch carrying expect.objectContaining({ type: 'docx', content: (the post-embed html), exportPin: expect.any(Object) }) beside the full pageOptions, exactly one save dialog whose payload asserts filters: [{ name: 'Word', extensions: ['docx'] }], the double consumed once with the same html the dispatch carried, window.fileUtils.writeFile called exactly once with the resolved path and 'binary' mode, and the lifecycle half — expect(mockPrinter.renderMarkdown).not.toHaveBeenCalled() and expect(mockPrinter.clearup).not.toHaveBeenCalled(): the branch creates no container (editor.vue:2592-2594), so nothing exists to clear.

Pin two (named failing-first, lands green — coverage-first): «docx: a render-stage failure surfaces the Word-branch failure notice and dispatches nothing» — mockEditorInstance.exportStyledHTML rejects before any dispatch (the editor-coverage pdf/print error precedent :2280/:2317 applied to the docx leg); assert exactly one noticeMock.notify with title 'editor.export.failed' (editor.vue's useI18n t resolves the key verbatim under the suite's empty-message en plugin) and type 'error' (the :2289-2291 objectContaining precedent), zero store EXPORT dispatches, no save dialog, no conversion, zero writeFile calls, zero print-container activity.

Pin three (meaningful-proof, recorded honestly as handoff coverage): «docx: a conversion failure reaches the store's catch through exactly one dispatch» — save resolves to a .docx path, the double rejects; assert exactly one store EXPORT dispatch (the handoff), exactly one noticeMock.notify call overall raised by the store's catch (store/editor.js:2316-2323) whose title asserts the real-singleton interpolation 'Word export failed' with severity 'error', no editor.vue-level duplicate notice, zero binary writes, zero print-container activity. Not a defect detector — the store leg always notifies and is pinned in isolation; this pin proves the component→store handoff still reaches it.
